{{Top|leg}}
A '''knowledge matrix''' was part of a [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] programming. When the [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droid]] was being designed, the prototype knowledge matrices were sent to [[Rhinnal State Medical Academy]] where some of the best [[Doctor/Legends|doctors]] added their expertise to the matrix, refining the programming. [[SE4 servant droid]]s were hardwired with several knowledge matrices to give them expertise in several disciplines such as the culinary arts, party planning, and home economics.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
